_note: The CEO's parent intake questionnaire (16 Oct 2026, @Abdulloh Ochilov; therapist-reviewed), as data. Source of truth for the server (app/modules/intake/questionnaire.py) and the website (a copy in apps/web/src/content/backend/questionnaire.json, checked by questionnaire.test.ts). Question numbers never change and are never reused. `show` holds display rules R1-R19 and the follow-ups as one condition; `option_show` hides single options. Conditions: {q, in} (any of these answers), {q, answered}, {q, min/max} (numbers), {fact, in/min/max} with facts age (years), gmfcs, macs, cfcs (1-5, from C10/L2, D1, G2), {all}, {any}, {not}, and {ref} to a named rule in `defs`. `note` marks the team's drafts and open points for the physio.
